description.value: The Train Station Pub occupies Kelowna's historic 1926 CN railway station, one of the few remaining heritage station buildings in the BC Interior still in active daily use. Part of the Station Hospitality Group, it serves food, local beer, wine, and craft cocktails in a characterful setting that doubles as a community gathering spot. Touring cyclists rolling into downtown Kelowna will find a full-service pub with an early-day menu starting at 9 am.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is active (©2025, online ordering, loyalty program, merchandise store) with address 1177 Ellis Street, Kelowna, BC and phone (778) 484-5558 both matching OSM exactly. The 'Order Online' navigation link provides positive evidence for takeout. No bike-specific amenities, Wi-Fi, or water refill details appear anywhere in the fetched website content, so those fields are null. The site notes it is 'currently getting a refresh,' which may explain thin content.
concerns: Opening hours inconsistency across website pages: footer on most pages shows Monday 9:00am–10:00pm and Tue–Thu 9:00am–11:00pm, while the /connect/ subpage shows Monday 11:00am–10:00pm and Tue–Thu 11:00am–11:00pm. OSM records Mo 11:00–22:00, consistent with the /connect/ page. Site notes it is 'currently getting a refresh,' suggesting some pages may be stale.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, publicly accessible heritage pub in downtown Kelowna confirmed open via 2025 website content with matching contact details.
enrichment_extras.notes: Historic 1926 CN station building; OSM tags both amenity=pub and historic=train_station. Station Hospitality Group also operates a second Kelowna venue, Mid-Town Station Kitchen + Drink, referenced on the gift cards and sponsorship pages.
